definition: A full-company comparable must represent the target's current business mix; matching only one small or unquantified activity is not sufficient for whole-company EV/EBITDA.
scope: Post-run analyst review of the five peer decisions changed by the split-context prompt; diagnostic, not blinded labels or an accuracy estimate.

pairs.reason: AFG sold its annuity business and is currently a specialty P&C insurer; F&G sells annuity and life insurance products.
Boston Omaha operates broadband, billboards, surety and asset management; Baldwin is primarily an insurance distribution firm.
Goosehead is an insurance agency, while insurance is only one of Boston Omaha's four current businesses.

Carlisle focuses on building-envelope materials; CSW is a diversified contractor-products company with HVAC/R as its largest market. Overlap in some building products does not establish a close whole-company match.

Both operate water parks, but Lucky Strike also has 361 non-water-park locations out of 366 and reports 45% of FY2026 revenue from bowling; United Parks is a park operator. Shared water parks alone are insufficient for a whole-company comp.
